profile.name: USB设备连通性诊断组件
profile.description: 这是一个非实体软件组件，用于在实验系统中描述USB设备并执行连接诊断。它主要检查设备是否可见、是否映射为POSIX端口、端口路径是否有效、端口能否打开，以及是否能够进行命令读写，以帮助排查仪器与主机之间的USB连接问题。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software component used in laboratory systems to describe USB devices and perform connectivity diagnostics. It checks whether a device is visible, whether it appears as a POSIX port, whether port paths are valid, whether ports can be opened, and whether command read/write is possible, helping troubleshoot USB connections between instruments and host computers.

registry.name: Open Standard USB Parameters
registry.description: USB Device Description是由Open Standard生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括打开、设备连接、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, assertEqual等操作。
